# Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("All matrices must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("All matrices must be 2D")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All entries must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All entries must be nonpositive")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n, horizon = shape
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    L_with = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call)
    margin = L_minus - L_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
